hypotheses.title: W1-output-spill: Oversized tool output spills to a file with a preview and the path
hypotheses.plan: Over 2000 lines or 50 KB, write the full output under the run workspace and return head/tail preview plus the path.
hypotheses.expected: unit test for spill and preview

hypotheses.title: W1-fuzzy-edit: Fuzzy edit application (whitespace-normalized, then block-anchor match)
hypotheses.plan: When exact match fails, try line-trimmed match, then first/last-line anchors with Levenshtein similarity; refuse ambiguous matches.
hypotheses.expected: unit tests for each fallback and ambiguity refusal

hypotheses.title: W1-post-write-diagnostics: Diagnostics right after a write (py_compile / configured linters)
hypotheses.plan: After write_file/edit_file on .py run py_compile (and ruff if present); append errors to the tool result.
hypotheses.expected: unit test that a syntax error is reported in the same tool result

hypotheses.title: W1-compaction: Context compaction for the native runtime — clear old tool outputs, then summarize
hypotheses.plan: Over a token threshold, replace tool_result contents older than two turns with placeholders; above a second threshold, summarize the head into one message.
hypotheses.expected: unit test with a long synthetic conversation; no benchmark regression

hypotheses.title: W1-snapshots: Shadow-git snapshot per run; rejected attempt can be reverted
hypotheses.plan: Snapshot the deliverables directory before each run in a separate git dir; on rejection with "start over" guidance, restore it.
